name: Bernice
source: A maid in the castle where Liliane is being held captive. She loves the queen more than anything in the world thinking that she and her family are alive only because of Liliane's kindness, and because of that she is ready to do anything for her. Clumsy, and naive, but very sincere in all of her actions.
